## Study description


In each of 5 reps 25 1/10 acre circular plots were planted with 34 1-0 (1 year old) Douglas fir seedlings. 5 plots per rep were  each assigned to a treatment: DF0Y, RA10Y, CW10Y, RA20Y, CW20Y. (plots = 125, tmt = 5, rep = 5, plots/tmt/rep = 5). 34 seedlings/plot = approx 4,250 trees.   

## Importing data
Two multi-sheet workboooks were provided by Anna Leon of Weyerhauser (Anna.Leon@weyerhaeuser.com). One with keys for metadata codes and one with coded data plus a dictionary for column names

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(readr)
#reading in code sheets form metadata workbook
Apiary_TMTs <- read_excel("C:/Users/showa/Documents/LeBoldus_Lab/Laminated_Root_Rot/Apiariy_LRR/raw_data/Apiary_2020_Path_Data_All_for_Jared_2.xlsx", sheet = "Treatments")
colnames(Apiary_TMTs)<-c("TMT_code","TMT_short","TMT_name")

Species_codes <- read_excel("C:/Users/showa/Documents/LeBoldus_Lab/Laminated_Root_Rot/Apiariy_LRR/raw_data/Apiary_Measurement_Codes.xls",sheet = "Species_Codes", range = "A5:B130", col_names = FALSE)
colnames(Species_codes)<-c("Species_Code","Species_name")

Origin_codes <- read_excel("C:/Users/showa/Documents/LeBoldus_Lab/Laminated_Root_Rot/Apiariy_LRR/raw_data/Apiary_Measurement_Codes.xls",sheet = "Origin_Codes", range = "A5:B10", col_names = FALSE)
colnames(Origin_codes)<-c("Origin_Code","Origin")

Status_codes <- read_excel("C:/Users/showa/Documents/LeBoldus_Lab/Laminated_Root_Rot/Apiariy_LRR/raw_data/Apiary_Measurement_Codes.xls",sheet = "Status_Codes", range = "A5:B19", col_names = FALSE)
colnames(Status_codes)<-c("Status_Code","Status")

Damage_codes <- read_excel("C:/Users/showa/Documents/LeBoldus_Lab/Laminated_Root_Rot/Apiariy_LRR/raw_data/Apiary_Measurement_Codes.xls",sheet = "Damage_Codes", range = "A5:B62", col_names = FALSE)
colnames(Damage_codes)<-c("Damage_Code","Damage")

Position_codes <- read_excel("C:/Users/showa/Documents/LeBoldus_Lab/Laminated_Root_Rot/Apiariy_LRR/raw_data/Apiary_Measurement_Codes.xls",sheet = "Position_Codes", range = "A7:B14", col_names = FALSE)
colnames(Position_codes)<-c("Position_Code","Position")

Damage_amount_codes <- read_excel("C:/Users/showa/Documents/LeBoldus_Lab/Laminated_Root_Rot/Apiariy_LRR/raw_data/Apiary_Measurement_Codes.xls",sheet = "Amount_Codes", range = "A5:B54", col_names = FALSE)
colnames(Damage_amount_codes)<-c("Damage_Amount_Code","Damage_Amount")

#reading in dictionary sheet from data workbook
Data_dict <- read_excel("C:/Users/showa/Documents/LeBoldus_Lab/Laminated_Root_Rot/Apiariy_LRR/raw_data/Apiary_2020_Path_Data_All_for_Jared_2.xlsx",sheet = "Data_Dictionary", range = "A3:B23", col_names = FALSE)
colnames(Data_dict)<-c("Column_Name","Description")

#reading in data
A_plots <- read_excel("C:/Users/showa/Documents/LeBoldus_Lab/Laminated_Root_Rot/Apiariy_LRR/raw_data/Apiary_2020_Path_Data_All_for_Jared_2.xlsx",sheet = "A-Plots", col_names = TRUE)
#unique(A_plots$AMT1)
A_plots$AMT1[A_plots$AMT1==0]<-NA

B_plots <- read_excel("C:/Users/showa/Documents/LeBoldus_Lab/Laminated_Root_Rot/Apiariy_LRR/raw_data/Apiary_2020_Path_Data_All_for_Jared_2.xlsx",sheet = "B-Plots", col_names = TRUE)

C_plots <- read_excel("C:/Users/showa/Documents/LeBoldus_Lab/Laminated_Root_Rot/Apiariy_LRR/raw_data/Apiary_2020_Path_Data_All_for_Jared_2.xlsx",sheet = "C-Plots", col_names = TRUE)
#checking nonconforming trt entries with "y" instead of "Y"
#unique(C_plots$TRT)
C_plots$TRT[C_plots$TRT=="DF0y"]<-"DF0Y"

D_plots <- read_excel("C:/Users/showa/Documents/LeBoldus_Lab/Laminated_Root_Rot/Apiariy_LRR/raw_data/Apiary_2020_Path_Data_All_for_Jared_2.xlsx",sheet = "D-Plots", col_names = TRUE)
#checking nonconforming trt entries with "y" instead of "Y"
#unique(D_plots$TRT)
#unique(D_plots$DAM1)
#unique(D_plots$AMT1)
D_plots$TRT[D_plots$TRT=="RA20y"]<-"RA20Y"
D_plots$DAM1[D_plots$DAM1=="Blank"]<-NA
D_plots$AMT1[D_plots$AMT1=="Blank"]<-NA

E_plots <- read_excel("C:/Users/showa/Documents/LeBoldus_Lab/Laminated_Root_Rot/Apiariy_LRR/raw_data/Apiary_2020_Path_Data_All_for_Jared_2.xlsx",sheet = "E-Plots", col_names = TRUE)

#combine all treatments together into one dataset and change coded variables to factors rather than numbers
combined_data<-rbind(A_plots,B_plots,C_plots,D_plots,E_plots)
#unique(combined_data$TRT)
combined_data$LOC<-as.factor(combined_data$LOC)
combined_data$PLOT<-as.factor(combined_data$PLOT)
combined_data$SUBPLOT<-as.factor(combined_data$SUBPLOT)
combined_data$REP<-as.factor(combined_data$REP)
combined_data$TRT<-as.factor(combined_data$TRT)
combined_data$TREE<-as.factor(combined_data$TREE)
combined_data$SP<-as.factor(combined_data$SP)
combined_data$OR<-as.factor(combined_data$OR)
combined_data$OSTS<-as.factor(combined_data$OSTS)
combined_data$NSTS<-as.factor(combined_data$NSTS)
combined_data$DAM1<-as.factor(combined_data$DAM1)
combined_data$POS1<-as.factor(combined_data$POS1)
combined_data$AMT1<-as.factor(combined_data$AMT1)

#removing false zeros for DBH measurements
combined_data$NDBH[combined_data$NDBH==0]<-NA
combined_data$ODBH[combined_data$ODBH==0]<-NA

#saveRDS(combined_data, file="C:/Users/showa/Documents/LeBoldus_Lab/Laminated_Root_Rot/Apiariy_LRR/raw_data/combined_trt_data.Rds")

#write.csv(combined_data, file="C:/Users/showa/Documents/LeBoldus_Lab/Laminated_Root_Rot/Apiariy_LRR/raw_data/combined_trt_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Data Summarization

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
#combined_data<- readRDS("C:/Users/showa/Documents/LeBoldus_Lab/Laminated_Root_Rot/Apiariy_LRR/raw_data/combined_trt_data.Rds")

TRTxREP_summary<-combined_data %>% group_by(TRT, REP, .drop=FALSE) %>% summarise(count=n())
TRTxREP_summary
ggplot(TRTxREP_summary,aes(x=TRT,y=count,fill=REP ))+geom_col()+scale_fill_viridis_d()+ylab("Tree count")+xlab("Treatment")

TRTxNSTS_summary<-combined_data %>% group_by(TRT, NSTS) %>% summarise(count=n())
TRTxNSTS_summary
ggplot(TRTxNSTS_summary,aes(x=TRT,y=count,fill=NSTS ))+geom_col()+scale_fill_viridis_d()+ylab("Tree count")+xlab("Treatment")

TRTxOSTS_summary<-combined_data %>% group_by(TRT, OSTS) %>% summarise(count=n())
TRTxOSTS_summary
#ggplot(TRTxOSTS_summary,aes(x=TRT,y=count,fill=OSTS ))+geom_col()+scale_fill_viridis_d()+ylab("Tree count")+xlab("Treatment")

#TRTxDAM_summary<-combined_data %>% group_by(TRT, DAM1) %>% summarise(count=n())
#TRTxDAM_summary

DAM_summary<-combined_data %>% group_by(DAM1) %>% summarise(count=n())
DAM_summary
#write.csv(DAM_summary, file="C:/Users/showa/Documents/LeBoldus_Lab/Laminated_Root_Rot/Apiariy_LRR/raw_data/DAM_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

AMT_summary<-combined_data %>% group_by(AMT1) %>% summarise(count=n())
AMT_summary

DAMxAMT_summary<-combined_data %>% group_by(DAM1, AMT1) %>% summarise(count=n())
DAMxAMT_summary

POS_summary<-combined_data %>% group_by(POS1) %>% summarise(count=n())
POS_summary

OR_summary<-combined_data %>% group_by(OR) %>% summarise(count=n())
OR_summary

#returning the entries for which AMT1 is 808, an invalid code
#AMT_808<-combined_data[which(combined_data$AMT1 == 808),]
#write.csv(AMT_808, file="C:/Users/showa/Documents/LeBoldus_Lab/Laminated_Root_Rot/Apiariy_LRR/raw_data/amt_808_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)

#fix
combined_data$AMT1[combined_data$AMT1 == 808]<-NA

#returning the entries for which NDBH is NA or 0 without explanation
DBH_NA<-combined_data[is.na(combined_data$NDBH),]
DBH_NA_no_explain<-DBH_NA[is.na(DBH_NA$AMT1),]
#write.csv(DBH_NA_no_explain, file="C:/Users/showa/Documents/LeBoldus_Lab/Laminated_Root_Rot/Apiariy_LRR/raw_data/DBH_NA_no_explain_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)

#returning the entries for which SP is NA
#SP_0<-combined_data[is.na(combined_data$SP),]
#fix
combined_data$SP<-"DF"
#write.csv(SP_0, file="C:/Users/showa/Documents/LeBoldus_Lab/Laminated_Root_Rot/Apiariy_LRR/raw_data/SP_0_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
